name: alibaba/qwen3.8-max-0902
description: Qwen3.8 Max (0902) is the pinned snapshot of Alibaba's Qwen3.8 Max dated September 2, 2026, intended for workloads that need a fixed version. Alibaba describes it as an upgraded snapshot with stronger engineering-scale coding and long-horizon autonomous development, steadier multi-tool orchestration and end-to-end task delivery, and refined chart reasoning, document parsing and multimodal perception. It keeps the flagship's vision input, thinking mode and full tool support.
